convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'NarrowestRangeSignal' custom indicator which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. Pending stop-order management with dual-sided bracket orders. Custom signal logic depends on external indicator buffer values.

derived_values.name: range high price
derived_values.formula: ArrayMaximum(high) over bars_in_range+1 bars from bar 0
derived_values.used_by: Buy Stop price and Sell Stop SL

derived_values.name: range low price
derived_values.formula: ArrayMinimum(low) over bars_in_range+1 bars from bar 0
derived_values.used_by: Sell Stop price and Buy Stop SL

params.note: SL is opposite side of range: Buy SL = min_low-indent, Sell SL = max_high+indent; pips = InpIndent(50) + range_width + InpIndent(50), variable per signal

other_exits: When a position exists, all pending orders are deleted (opposite stop order removed on fill)
No explicit position close logic - positions held until TP or SL hit

position_sizing.conditional_logic: FIXED_LOT=use InpVolume as lot size; FIXED_PERCENT=calculate lot from (free_margin/1000/leverage)*InpVolume then normalize and validate

custom_logic_notes: Dual bracket stop orders placed on both sides of narrowest range. Buy Stop at max_high+indent with SL at min_low-indent; Sell Stop at min_low-indent with SL at max_high+indent. When either order fills (position exists), the opposite pending order is deleted. Range must not have its high or low at the most recent bar (ArrayMaximum/ArrayMinimum index != bars_in_range). Signal checked on bar [1] (CopyBuffer start=1). Buy Stop price is adjusted by adding (ask-bid) spread to account for stop order placement relative to bid. New bar guard uses static datetime comparison in both CheckOrders and DeletePendingOrders.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of NarrowestRangeSignal custom indicator logic (buffer 2 = signal flag, buffer 0/1 likely = range high/low). The iCustom call passes bars_in_range and check_period as parameters. The EA reads buffer index 2 to detect signal bars. Range detection uses ArrayMaximum/ArrayMinimum over high/low arrays of size bars_in_range+1. Must replicate the indicator's narrowest range detection algorithm or obtain its source. Pending order management (place/cancel bracket orders) must be replicated. Spread adjustment on Buy Stop price (price += ask-bid) is broker-specific behavior to note.
